CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

BEGIN

INSERT INTO public.profiles (

    id,

    email,

    created_at,

    updated_at

)

VALUES (

    NEW.id,

    NEW.email,

    NOW(),

    NOW()

);

RETURN NEW;

END;

$function$
